rundown: Macarthur beat Melbourne C 2-0 at Campbelltown Sports Stadium in Sydney. Macarthur led 2-0 at half-time and never looked back.
Goals: Melbourne C none; Macarthur Apostolos Stamatelopoulos 5', Ryan Fraser 33'.

Leading the way — Melbourne C: Harrison Delbridge 3 total shots, 53 accurate passes; Julio Cascante 14 defensive interventions. Macarthur: Ryan Fraser 2 total shots; Tatsuki Nara 55 accurate passes; Harry Politidis 14 defensive interventions.
Where Macarthur won it: they put 5 on target to 1.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Macarthur won as the underdog at +185; the total closed at 2.5 and they combined for 2, under by 0.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 27, 3:39 AM ET. It had Melbourne C 32%, the draw 28% and Macarthur 40%, projecting Melbourne C 1.2 – Macarthur 1.4 (2.5 total, Macarthur by 0.2).

Final: Melbourne C 0 – Macarthur 2. Right winner: it had Macarthur at 40%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Melbourne C came in with a league-average attack and a 2% stingier than average defense (2-1-1, 1.5 scored and 1.5 allowed a game over 4 games), worth about 23 and 23 games of evidence. Projected to score 1.2, they scored 0 (−1.2 goals, 100% under); projected to allow 1.4, they allowed 2 (+0.6 goals, 47% over).

Macarthur came in with a league-average attack and a 7% leakier than average defense (2-2-1, 1.2 scored and 1 allowed a game over 5 games), worth about 24 and 24 games of evidence. Projected to score 1.4, they scored 2 (+0.6 goals, 47% over); projected to allow 1.2, they allowed 0 (−1.2 goals, 100% under).

The bigger miss was Melbourne C's scoring (-1.2 goals against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 2 against 2.5 projected (-0.5), about the 37th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±1.7).

Margin: Macarthur by 2 against Macarthur by 0.2 projected, about the 86th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±1.7).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

OVER 2.5 (-135) at -135: the algo gave it 54% vs 54% fair (-0.5 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin.

The result was off its normal range without being an outlier, so the flags may have played a part.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.782 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +1.8 goals. It counts toward Soccer scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 2019 graded Soccer games the algo now scales scoring ×0.940 and gives home teams 0 goals. Team corrections so far: Melbourne C attack ×0.960, defense ×1.031 (4 games); Macarthur attack ×0.994, defense ×0.960 (6 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 1.8 goals), no bet.
